entries.wording: Shipment is out with courier for delivery
Delivery attempted but no response at Consignee address
Shipment is in transit to destination
Supplementary information has been received and merged with applicable shipment data
entries.note: The shipper's further data joined to the shipment's record, seen before the shipment information itself. Read by its wording; the unified feed codes it EM.
Followed by the facility, as in "Processed at <city> - <country>"; matched on its start.
Followed by the facility; matched on its start.
Followed by the facility; matched on its start.

entries.wording: Scheduled to depart on the next planned movement
entries.note: Waiting at a facility for its next linehaul or flight. The unified feed codes it SM; the mobile API sends the wording alone.
A delivery booked for a later round, as after a failed attempt; the courier's round comes as its own scan.

entries.wording: Shipment has departed from a DHL facility
entries.note: Followed by the facility; matched on its start.
Followed by the facility. A completed clearance puts the parcel back in transit.

entries.wording: Customs clearance status updated. Note - The Customs clearance process
entries.note: Matched on its start; the clearance is still under way.
Followed by the facility. Not the Processed at checkpoint: the parcel is in customs. The unified feed codes it IC, which stages it in any wording.
A clearance step without its outcome; the parcel is still in customs. The unified feed codes it CD, which stages it in any wording.

entries.wording: Payment is received and recorded for shipment related fees
entries.note: The recipient's duties or fees are paid between clearance updates; the parcel stays in customs until the clearance completes. The unified feed codes it PY, which stages it in any wording.
The unified feed codes it SA, which stages it in any wording.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at incorrect facility. It will be sent to the correct destination
entries.note: A missort: the parcel goes on to the right facility, late. The unified feed codes it MS; the web feed sends the wording alone.
Held at a DHL facility for the consignee to collect; matched on its start. The unified feed codes it CC, which stages it in any wording.

entries.wording: Delivery attempt could not be completed
entries.note: Matched on its start. The unified feed codes it ND, which stages it in any wording.
The unified feed codes it RT, which stages it in any wording.
